Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

[{"id": "arka-boost-transcribe-medium-0037", "row_sha256": "8b89a2e996c6b3597a871e7358f54a732361d139eb26be62b0fdc23260eda763", "mode": "/transcribe", "language": "en", "context": {}, "identity": false, "mode_instructions": "Remove true hesitation and accidental restarts. Apply explicit corrections to the final stated intent. Preserve meaningful filler-like words and unfinished thoughts. Apply clearly spoken punctuation and list cues. Keep the supplied language.", "input": "we are forwarding the screen reader audit notes to the accessibility team before thursday so they can review the booking page during the next test window i checked the page with the keyboard and with two screen readers on a laptop in the east meeting room the first item is the date picker it announces the selected month but not the year the second item is the seat map each seat has a name but the available seats and reserved seats sound almost the same when you move through them the third item is the confirmation link it is reachable after the payment summary but the focus indicator is hard to see at high magnification well i wrote down the browser version and the test account used for each check i also noted that the screen reader was set to speak punctuation at its default level the the focus indicator issue appeared on both browsers but i did not test it on a phone the audit notes include the exact page address and the time of each observation please keep the screenshots with the matching test notes and send any questions to me before the review meeting", "output": "We are forwarding the screen reader audit notes to the accessibility team before Thursday, so they can review the booking page during the next test window. I checked the page with the keyboard and with two screen readers on a laptop in the east meeting room. The first item is the date picker: it announces the selected month but not the year. The second item is the seat map. Each seat has a name, but the available seats and reserved seats sound almost the same when you move through them. The third item is the confirmation link. It is reachable after the payment summary, but the focus indicator is hard to see at high magnification. Well, I wrote down the browser version and the test account used for each check. I also noted that the screen reader was set to speak punctuation at its default level. The focus indicator issue appeared on both browsers, but I did not test it on a phone. The audit notes include the exact page address and the time of each observation. Please keep the screenshots with the matching test notes and send any questions to me before the review meeting."}]
